article-meta.article-title: Archival Dispatch: 28 Master Broadcasts Dated Across Air Adventures of Biggles, Excursions in Science, V-Discs, and Classic Radio Themes
article-meta.kwd-group: Biggles, Australian OTR, Excursions in Science, V-Discs, Count Basie, Philip Marlowe, Tom Corbett, Original Filenames

sec.title: Batch 34 Forensic Discoveries
sec.p: Batch 34 resolves 28 historical radio master recordings across four unique archival categories: 8 Australian aviation serial episodes from Grace Gibson's ***The Air Adventures of Biggles*** (1950–1951), 8 General Electric science documentary broadcasts from ***Excursions in Science*** (1944–1948), 7 War Department overseas master discs from the ***V-Disc Collection*** (featuring Count Basie, Bing Crosby, Dinah Shore, Woody Herman, and the 1944 Esquire Met Opera Jam Session), and 5 classic network broadcast opening themes from ***Themes*** (including *The Adventures of Philip Marlowe*, *Tom Corbett Space Cadet*, and *DuPont Cavalcade of Music*).

sec.title: 1. *Air Adventures of Biggles* — 1950–1951 Australian Radio Serials
sec.p: Adapted from W.E. Johns and produced by Grace Gibson Productions in Sydney:
sec.table: | Original Circulating Filename | Canonical Title | Verified Airdate | Aviation Narrative Arc | |---|---|---|---| | `Biggles_Sweeps_Desert_11.mp3` | **"Air Adventures of Biggles: Biggles Sweeps the Desert (Part 11)"** | **1950-03-27** | Recapturing the Catalina flying boat under fire from von Stalhein. | | `Biggles_Sweeps_Desert_13.mp3` | **"Air Adventures of Biggles: Biggles Sweeps the Desert (Part 13)"** | **1950-03-29** | Fighting through the thorn bushes of Man-o'-War Bay. | | `Biggles_Sweeps_Desert_14.mp3` | **"Air Adventures of Biggles: Biggles Sweeps the Desert (Part 14)"** | **1950-03-30** | Recovering the stolen intelligence documents from the island vessel. | | `Biggles_Sweeps_Desert_15.mp3` | **"Air Adventures of Biggles: Biggles Sweeps the Desert (Part 15)"** | **1950-04-03** | Enemy submarine approaches the desert island rendezvous. | | `Biggles_Sweeps_Desert_16.mp3` | **"Air Adventures of Biggles: Biggles Sweeps the Desert (Part 16)"** | **1950-04-04** | Tactical aerial bombing plan to repel the enemy submarine. | | `Biggles_Sweeps_Desert_18.mp3` | **"Air Adventures of Biggles: Biggles Sweeps the Desert (Part 18)"** | **1950-04-06** | Seaboard cave search and final confrontation. | | `Biggles_Black_Raider_2.mp3` | **"Air Adventures of Biggles: The Black Raider (Part 2)"** | **1951-01-16** | Tracking outlaw air pirates over Lake Tanganyika. | | `Biggles_Black_Raider_3.mp3` | **"Air Adventures of Biggles: The Black Raider (Part 3)"** | **1951-01-17** | Mosquito aircraft reconnaissance into the Central African interior. |

sec.title: 2. *Excursions in Science* — 1944–1948 General Electric Research Lab
sec.p: Broadcast over WGY Schenectady and national syndication:
sec.table: | Original Circulating Filename | Canonical Title | Verified Airdate | Scientific Innovation | |---|---|---|---| | `Excursions_Science_Radiology_Wartime.mp3` | **"Excursions in Science: Radiology and X-Ray in Wartime (GE Research)"** | **1944-08-16** | Industrial and medical diagnostic advances during WWII. | | `Excursions_Science_Electronic_Warfare.mp3` | **"Excursions in Science: Electronic Warfare and Radar"** | **1945-11-21** | The secret wartime development of microwave radar and countermeasures. | | `Excursions_Science_Mexicos_Volcano.mp3` | **"Excursions in Science: Mexico's New Volcano (Parícutin)"** | **1946-04-10** | Geologists document the sudden 1943 eruption of Parícutin in Michoacán. | | `Excursions_Science_Birth_Planet.mp3` | **"Excursions in Science: The Birth of a Planet"** | **1947-02-19** | Astrophysical models of planetary formation in our solar system. | | `Excursions_Science_Way_Without_Instruments.mp3` | **"Excursions in Science: Finding Your Way Without Instruments"** | **1947-09-24** | Natural celestial navigation and wilderness survival techniques. | | `Excursions_Science_Physics_Ideas.mp3` | **"Excursions in Science: Elementary Ideas of Physics"** | **1947-06-11** | Fundamental principles of energy, motion, and thermodynamics. | | `Excursions_Science_Human_Heredity.mp3` | **"Excursions in Science: Human Heredity and Genetics"** | **1948-03-03** | Post-war developments in genetics and biological inheritance. | | `Excursions_Science_Superstition.mp3` | **"Excursions in Science: Superstition and Pseudoscience"** | **1948-05-19** | Applying the scientific method to debunk popular superstitions. |

sec.title: 3. *V-Disc Master Discs* — 1943–1945 War Department Discs
sec.p: Pressed exclusively for Allied troops fighting overseas:
sec.table: | Original Circulating Filename | Canonical Title | Verified Airdate | Musical Selection | |---|---|---|---| | `V_Disc_024B_Dinah_Shore_Bing_Crosby.mp3` | **"V-Disc 024B: Dinah Shore & Bing Crosby ('Way Down Yonder in New Orleans')"** | **1943-11-01** | Upbeat jazz vocal duet recorded for troops overseas. | | `V_Disc_274A_Bing_Crosby_Could_Happen.mp3` | **"V-Disc 274A: Bing Crosby ('It Could Happen to You')"** | **1944-09-15** | Bing Crosby sings the Jimmy Van Heusen wartime ballad. | | `V_Disc_247A_Howard_Barlow_Sailors_Dance.mp3` | **"V-Disc 247A: Howard Barlow and the Columbia Symphony ('Russian Sailor's Dance')"** | **1944-08-01** | High-energy classical orchestral recording for service personnel. | | `V_Disc_153B_Boston_Symphony_Rosamunde.mp3` | **"V-Disc 153B: Boston Symphony Orchestra & Serge Koussevitzky ('Schubert Rosamunde')"** | **1944-03-15** | Master recording of Schubert's ballet music conducted by Koussevitzky. | | `V_Disc_389B_Woody_Herman_Blue_Flame.mp3` | **"V-Disc 389B: Woody Herman and His Orchestra ('Blue Flame')"** | **1945-02-15** | Signature big band swing theme recorded specifically for military overseas shipment. | | `V_Disc_152B_Esquire_All_Star_Mop_Mop.mp3` | **"V-Disc 152B: Esquire Metropolitan Opera All-Star Jam ('Mop Mop')"** | **1944-03-15** | Historic jazz jam session live from the Metropolitan Opera House stage. | | `V_Disc_258A_Count_Basie_Beaver_Junction.mp3` | **"V-Disc 258A: Count Basie and His Orchestra ('Beaver Junction')"** | **1944-08-15** | Count Basie's Kansas City swing rhythm recorded for overseas GI listeners. |
